summary: # Marvelous Designer 2024.0 New Features: Marvelous Designer LiveSync (Unreal Engine Plugin) ## Introduction to LiveSync LiveSync is a tool designed to connect Marvelous Designer with a virtual editor. This feature allows seamless import and export of files between Marvelous Designer and virtual editors. ## Installation Process To download the necessary files required for installing the virtual engine, follow these steps: 1. Click on the main menu to access Marvelous Designer LiveSync. 2. A web page will pop up where you can learn more about the plugin and download it. 3. Scroll down the page and click on "Get LiveSync" to start downloading the plugin. Additionally, please consult the manual on the Connect page to understand how to install and use this plugin. ### Prerequisites Before proceeding, ensure that you download the Substance 3D virtual engine plugin first. This is essential for using Substance materials on Marvelous Designer clothing. Otherwise, the clothing will default to using standard materials. ## Installation Steps 1. Unzip the downloaded zip file and install LiveSync to Virtual Engine 5.3. 2. Place the Cloud LiveSync file in the plugin folder of your virtual engine. The path is as follows: ``` Epic Games -> UE5.3 -> Engine -> Plugins -> Marketplace ``` 3. Within this folder, you will also find a Substance 3D plugin folder. Open it. ### Configuring the Unreal Project 1. Open the Unreal project. 2. Ensure that both the Cloud LiveSync and Substance 3D plugins are available in the plugin settings. Navigate to: - Edit -> Project Settings - Go to the Windows project and set the default RHI value to DirectX 11. > **Note:** Setting DirectX 12 may cause Unreal Engine 5.3 to crash unexpectedly. 3. Search for "transparency," then open and enable the experimental option to remove local transparency. 4. Restart the virtual editor. ## Using Unified Material Option To utilize the unified material option, confirm that the UV picture is correctly arranged in the non-folded part. ### Updating the Model 1. Go to the window of the virtual machine and click on the CloudMD LiveSync Editor. 2. Click the update button to import the costume and virtual model into the CloudMD LiveSync Editor. 3. Ensure there is no active simulation or recording animation in Marvelous Designer. Switch to simulation mode or UV editor mode before clicking the update button. The created color changer in the virtual machine will match the fabric used in Marvelous Designer. ### Managing Assets - The Unified Material option is especially useful when applying it to costumes or when dealing with multiple secondary documents. - You can select the costume or virtual model from the object list on the left of the editor by clicking on it, then press the delete button to remove unwanted items. Once the assets in the LiveSync Editor have been uploaded to the virtual machine content browser, select the assets you need from the list on the left. This allows you to import both the virtual model and the costume. ### Saving Your Work - Click the save button and select the appropriate saved grid type. For file and animation purposes, save it as a Geometry Cache. - Choose the saved content browser path and click and drag the object to the scene. You will now be able to view the files created in Marvelous Designer within the virtual machine. ## Importing MetaHuman into Marvelous Designer LiveSync also allows you to import MetaHuman into Marvelous Designer. 1. Open Crystal Bridge from the virtual machine. 2. Download your MetaHuman and click "Add" to include it in your project. 3. Drag your MetaHuman to the window. You can use IK (Inverse Kinematics) to recreate animations in the virtual machine. ### Animation Setup 1. Drag your MetaHuman to the Sequencer. 2. Click the equal cell button next to the character's face name. 3. Add keys to a keyword in your Sequencer for the character's movements. Locate this key and click on proceed. 4. You can create a related animation series by clicking on the Body icon on the Sequencer and then save the animation series by selecting the path and saving it. After opening the animation series, you will see your MetaHuman's animation. ### Finalizing the Import There is a CLO LiveSync button at the top of the interface. Ensure you open the CLO MD LiveSync window simultaneously. Click on the CLO LiveSync button at the top of the toolbar to access the menu. After configuring the settings, click on the Export button. The MetaHuman skeleton with animation will be successfully imported into Marvelous Designer. You can now wear the costume and record the animation on the imported virtual model. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching! We hope you found this tutorial on the new features of Marvelous Designer 2024.0 and LiveSync helpful. See you in the next video!
